blocker.assertion: line 25: assert all(m["finish_reason"] == "stop" for m in msgs), arm
blocker.why: A3 has exactly 1 of its 60 rows with finish_reason "length" (the other four arms are all "stop"). The builder hard-asserts stop for every row of every arm, so it cannot build the pool as bound.

recommendation: relax the finish_reason assertion to ACCEPT "length" and RECORD it per arm/row, because the Panel-60 rubric grades answer content, not stop reason. This is a code edit, so per jerboa rule vizcacha authors it -> new builder hash -> shoveler addendum/re-review. NO RERUN: the length row is a real model outcome, and rerunning to force "stop" would be a valid-output rerun.
alternative_if_author_prefers: if the author wants the assertion kept, the binding must say explicitly how a non-stop row is handled; silently dropping or regenerating it is not acceptable.
